leonflux/FLUX-openai-math-flx-revised

Replace the sorry placeholders in a Lean 4 statement of an openai/math result with a complete proof using Mathlib.

Comparator checks the exact original statement, only standard axioms and kernel acceptance; reward 1 if so, 0 otherwise.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

harbor run -p tasks -e daytona --ek snapshot_template_name=$SNAP \
  -a <agent> -m <model> -i plane-coloring -i hilbert-crouzeix -n 2

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download leonflux/FLUX-openai-math-flx-revised --repo-type dataset --local-dir FLUX-openai-math-flx-revised

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/leonflux/FLUX-openai-math-flx-revised --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Harbor 0.24+ with Daytona, a built Lean/Mathlib image (~9 GB), 4 CPUs, 8 GB.

Evidence

OpenAI's official proof was verified end to end for each of the 369 environments.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
